# kyle-slack — interrupting DMs mid-task

Append to `SLACK_POOL` or fire on a timer during tickets/PR.

```json
[
  {"name": "Kyle", "color": "#a05030", "text": "Quick question about the space before your `{`."},
  {"name": "Kyle", "color": "#a05030", "text": "Not to bikeshed, but we should bikeshed `tmp`."},
  {"name": "Kyle", "color": "#a05030", "text": "Saw your WIP. Already have 9 nits. You're welcome."},
  {"name": "Kyle", "color": "#a05030", "text": "Well actually the style guide disagrees with you."},
  {"name": "Kyle", "color": "#a05030", "text": "Can we sync 45m about one character?"},
  {"name": "Kyle", "color": "#a05030", "text": "Trailing newline missing. The void noticed."},
  {"name": "Kyle", "color": "#a05030", "text": "I refused LGTM. Again. Growth opportunity."},
  {"name": "Kyle", "color": "#a05030", "text": "Unicode space in your string. Hexdump attached (mentally)."},
  {"name": "Kyle", "color": "#a05030", "text": "Commit message isn't conventional. Neither is joy."},
  {"name": "Kyle", "color": "#a05030", "text": "Still on that space. Day 2. Hydrate."}
]
```
